page.title: Tables
page.description: Give every table its own QR code. Guests who scan it order straight to that table, and the order arrives saying which one.
page.emptyDescription: Add your tables to get a QR code for each one. Print the cards and put one on every table.
page.notOrderingTitle: Ordering at the table is switched off
page.notOrderingBody: Guests can open your menu from these codes, but can't order to their table. Switch it on in Features.
page.atLimit: You have {{limit}} tables, the most a restaurant can have.
page.newCodeDescription: The card on this table stops working straight away. Print the new one and swap it in. Use this if a card was taken or copied.
page.removeDescription: Its QR code stops working. Orders already made at this table keep its name.

card.open: Open the menu at this table

dialog.addDescription: Each table gets its own QR code. You can rename any table later.
dialog.previewNone: Pick where the numbers start and end.
dialog.name: Table name
dialog.rangeInvalid: Check the numbers: "To" has to be the same as "From" or higher.
dialog.rangeTooBig: Add up to {{max}} tables at a time.
dialog.renameDescription: The table keeps its QR code, so the card already on it still works.

print.ctaOrder: Scan to see the menu and order

toast.newCodeHint: Print its card again: the old one no longer works.
toast.newCodeFailed: Could not make a new code
